evidence_basis: Cheriyan 2016: Methods and the pH 7.3 versus 6.4 spermine Results read from the PMC XML. Finding: the pH 6.4 spermine experiments used 100 uM glutamate plus 10 uM glycine (not NMDA); extracellular solution without Mg2+, pH 7.35; Vh -70 mV; HEK cells. This is a triheteromer spermine paper, not the native juvenile PFC neuron paper (that is Evlanenkov 2023).
